how_it_works.page_title: How It Works — SME Finance Copilot Operator Guide
how_it_works.hero_badge: SME Operator Guide • Autonomous Financial Workflow
how_it_works.hero_desc: From scanning multilingual paper invoices to generating GAAP-compliant general ledgers, 95% confidence cash runways, automated debt recovery, and 1-click institutional bank credit packets.
how_it_works.arch_title: An AI Participant, Not Just Another Record App
how_it_works.arch_desc: Unlike static accounting software where data must be manually keyed in, SME Finance Copilot actively participates in your business: watching cash thresholds, chasing overdue customers, forecasting liquidity, and assembling bank credit dossiers.
how_it_works.phase1_desc: Scan paper receipts, thermal chalan, cash memos, or PDF supplier invoices in Bengali, English, or Chinese.
how_it_works.phase2_desc: High-confidence extracts post automatically. Low-confidence invoices trigger review cards for one-click approval.
how_it_works.phase3_desc: All financial values are stored as immutable 64-bit integer minor units. Zero floating-point rounding errors.
how_it_works.phase4_desc: Machine learning models project daily liquidity with 95% confidence intervals and pinpoint cash shortage days.
how_it_works.phase5_desc: Categorizes customers with RFM analysis and drafts courteous WhatsApp or SMS payment reminders automatically.
how_it_works.phase6_desc: Computes verified DSCR metrics and exports tamper-evident PDF dossiers formatted for bank credit evaluation.
